image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a baby bib lying flat on a textured brown fabric surface. The bib is primarily orange with a raised, bubble-like texture (minky dot fabric). It features a large appliqué of an elephant's head and trunk on the right side, made from striped orange-and-white fabric and grey felt. The neck opening is reinforced with grey binding. A decorative black button or bead is visible near the trunk.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not another garment or toy.
To check for fusion artifacts between the striped ear/trunk and the main orange body, ensuring clean stitching lines.
To verify the consistency of the 'minky dot' texture and ensure no AI-generated melting or smearing in the raised bubbles.

focus_areas: Integrity of the elephant appliqué edges (no bleeding into background)
Consistency of the raised bubble texture across the surface
Realism of the fabric folds and shadows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the striped elephant ear and the orange body. AI often blurs these stitched boundaries. Also, verify if the 'bubbles' in the texture maintain consistent shape and lighting, or if they morph/melt near the edges.
